title: A Colony for the Horizon
author: Quentin Quintana
blurb: Kestrel Blackwood, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
